# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c38 P40](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0040)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie is stout or fat in build. She is described as having a face capable of looks that are triumphant, taunting, and defiant.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c33 P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034)_

## Personality

Josie is disagreeable, malicious, and sharp-tongued. She lacks imagination and is frequently sulky, cheat-like, or scornfully envious of others. She delights in taunting people and making unkind or sarcastic remarks.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P33](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0033), [v3 c11 P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041), [v3 c16 P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002)_

- walking board fences with skill and steadiness  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>

## Goals

- going to college for education's sake without needing to earn a living  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Josie attended Avonlea school alongside Anne Shirley and her classmates. She frequently traded dares with other students, successfully walking a board fence after daring Jane Andrews to hop on one leg, and later daring Anne Shirley to walk a ridgepole. When Miss Stacy organized recitations and dialogues, Josie was sulky because she was denied the role of fairy queen due to her stout figure. She later caused a three-month feud with Julia Bell after repeating a mean comment about Julia's reciting bow. At the exhibition, she won first prize for her knitted lace. She joined the Queen's class to prepare for entrance exams, stating she intended to go to college for education's sake since she would not need to earn a living. She attended Queen's Academy in the Second Class work, earning a reputation as the sharpest-tongued student there. Following her studies, she continued her education alongside her Avonlea peers, maintaining her taunting attitude toward Anne Shirley and accusing Anne of copying her prize-winning story.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c38 P40](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0040), [v3 c2 P3](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0003), [v3 c16 P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002)_

- member of the Pye family of Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c37 P33](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0033), [v1 c38 P40](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0040)</sub>
